next.reason: The range definition is kept (2023 says any 'transfer of control' rather than listing CALL, EXIT, GO TO, PERFORM) and so is the ban. 1985 'must not' states no result; 2023 says 'If this rule is violated, the EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the results of the merge operation are undefined' (§2023:14.9.24.4 GR8), and a RELEASE there also sets EC-FLOW-RELEASE (§2023:14.9.32.4 GR1). 2023 also refuses at compile time a MERGE written 'in an output procedure of another MERGE statement' (§2023:14.9.24.3 SR1) and a SORT written 'in an input or output procedure' (§2023:14.9.40.3 SR3); 1985 SR1 allowed both anywhere outside declaratives. Limiting the ban to 'the file format of the SORT statement' only exempts the new table SORT.
